props.name: align
props.description:
**Select alignment**
- **bottom** Dropdown panel appears on the bottom
- **top** Dropdown panel appears on the top

props.name: ariaDescribedBy
props.description:
Aria describedby
1. Used to connect the field note in select to the select menu for accessibility

props.name: fieldId
props.description: The unique id of the select

props.name: hasSearch
props.description: Add a search input to the dropdown panel

props.name: isActiveDropdown
props.description:
is Active select
1. Select is open when set to true. Close when set to false

props.name: isOptional
props.description:
Optional state
- Specifies that a field is optional and adds the text 'optional' to the label

props.name: isReadonly
props.description:
Readonly attribute
- Specifies that an input field is read-only

props.name: placeholder
props.description:
Placeholder attribute
- Specifies a short hint that describes the expected value of an input element

events.name: onSelectClose
events.description: Fired when the option list closes. Detail: `{ active }` — always `false`.

events.name: onSelectOpen
events.description: Fired when the option list opens. Detail: `{ active }` — always `true`.

slots.name: error
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property

slots.name: field-note
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property
